dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: We're gonna rest and regroup? Good. A wise decision.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: There's no telling what awaits us next. It's crucial that we take every opportunity to recover our strength.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: You should go hydrate — I'll handle the weapon maintenance. Once I'm done, they'll be good as new.
